dc:title: Google review removal denominator audit: 2024–2025 — 13 comparisons

columns.name: metric
columns.dc:description: Metric key shared with source records; different units must remain separate.

columns.name: before_record
columns.dc:description: 2024 source record ID in the source CSV.

columns.name: after_record
columns.dc:description: 2025 source record ID in the source CSV.

columns.name: unit
columns.dc:description: Measurement unit of the original displays.

columns.name: before_display
columns.dc:description: 2024 source display, preserving rounding or bounds.

columns.name: after_display
columns.dc:description: 2025 source display, preserving rounding or bounds.

columns.name: denominator
columns.dc:description: all_reviews_contributed for reason rates; blank for counts.

columns.name: nominal_delta
columns.dc:description: Difference between displayed magnitudes; blank where bounds do not identify a difference.

columns.name: nominal_relative_change_percent
columns.dc:description: 100 × (after − before) / before, using displayed values; not an exact event-count change.

columns.name: per_10000_before
columns.dc:description: Rescaled 2024 rate per illustrative 10,000 contributions, not an observed sample.

columns.name: per_10000_after
columns.dc:description: Rescaled 2025 rate per illustrative 10,000 contributions, not an observed sample.

columns.name: per_10000_operator
columns.dc:description: nominal_display_conversion for rescaling a displayed percentage; lt retains a strict upper bound.

columns.name: nominal_delta_unit
columns.dc:description: Unit of the nominal difference, including percentage_points for rates.

columns.name: interpretation
columns.dc:description: Limits on inference for this comparison.
